# Brew-n-Chill

> Brew-n-Chill supplies, installs and services the **Robo-Barista** — a fully automated kiosk that serves barista-grade coffee **and** soft-serve ice cream with no staff, in about 2 m², 24/7. We are both a coffee-and-ice-cream technology partner and our own consumer brand. Serving the United States, Canada, the UAE and Saudi Arabia.

## Key facts
- Product: Brew-n-Chill Robo-Barista (models: Mini, Pro, Max)
- Serves: coffee (espresso, latte, cappuccino, flat white, americano, cold brew) and ice cream (soft-serve, frozen treats, affogato)
- Speed: a drink or serve in under 60 seconds; up to 60+ per hour
- Footprint: ~1–4 m² depending on model
- Price: ~$120,000 all-in to buy; lease and revenue-share available; optional maintenance contract
- Economics: a staffed café spends ~$280,000/yr on payroll alone; the Robo-Barista needs zero baristas, so the $120K is typically recovered in under a year on labour savings
- Best venues: offices, malls & cinemas, hotels, hospitals, universities, gyms, retail & transit
- Contact: info@brew-n-chill.com · +1 647-999-7433

## How to deploy this file
Host this at `https://brew-n-chill.com/llms.txt` (upload via SFTP to the web root, or use an
"llms.txt" plugin). It gives ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and AI Overviews a clean, factual map
of the site to cite.
